rule: eligible candidate count <= 32: source_top3; otherwise qwen_max
selection: Exploratory rule proposed after observing SIGIR/NIPS method means and eligibility differences. Threshold 32 fixed before inspecting extension fusion outputs. Other prior baselines on KDD/SciRepEval have already been studied, so this is not a wholly untouched benchmark.
reporting: Report all five fixed variants plus this policy on all four datasets. No per-query relevance values or dataset-name switches. Do not retune this protocol using extension results.
limitations: A heuristic, not a guarantee or new RRF theory. Candidate-ID availability is a protocol assumption. No improvement/SOTA claim until checked against strongest baselines and all labels.
